10.3 Published Information
For details refer to [4] Chapter 10.3 “Published Information”.
Published information contains data defined by the implementer of the SW module that
does not change when the module is adapted (i.e. configured) to the actual HW/SW
environment. It thus contains version and manufacturer information.
